title: pm-eng-1on1-prep-priya-shah
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Marcus Li (Eng Lead, Serving Runtime)
When: 2026-02-13, 30m
Purpose: sync on priorities across API/Console/Dedicated/Private, unblock decisions for Q1 rollouts, capture action items

Quick context / what I want from this meeting
- Align on final rollout plan for hosted-api changes (rate limiting + batching) — need throughput estimates and canary plan.
- Confirm SLA/latency targets for Dedicated customers after kernel selection change.
- Surface any capacity or infra blockers for private deploy customers (VPC/on-prem packaging timeline).
- Get Marcus' assessment of risk for console rollout (new rollout UI) and whether we should delay by 1 sprint.

Agenda (proposed, please adjust)
1) 5m: Quick sync — what's top risk this week from eng side?
2) 10m: Hosted API batching & rate-limit changes — latency tradeoffs and canary strategy
   - metrics to discuss: P95 latency (current 180ms), tail spikes during peak (up to 420ms), token cost delta estimate with batching (expected -18%)
   - ask: production RPS we can safely canary at (target: 20% traffic)
3) 7m: Dedicated SLA/throughput after kernel update
   - need confirmation on throughput per GPU for common model families (Llama2-70b, Mistral-7b) and expected quantization impact
   - ask: timeline for benchmarks (ETA: end of this sprint?)
4) 5m: Private deployment blockers + packaging timeline
   - what's left for the on-prem installer (KMS/HSM integration, network docs)
5) 3m: AOB + next actions

Notes / prep points (things I already checked)
- Customer feedback: 2 customers reported latency regressions after last kernel swap during long-context runs (support tickets RED-4123, RED-4180). I read the traces — looks like KV cache misses at seq>2048.
- Console rollout: PMs shipped beta for rollout UI to ~5 internal users; some bugs in rollout logs UI (UI doesn't show fallback model). Marcus, I think you were going to prioritize the logging change?
- Dedicated: SRE ran limited throughput tests — numbers look promising but we need end-to-end tests with quantized models.

Key decisions I want to land
- Canary size and success metrics for hosted-api batching change (define rollback criteria)
- SLA numbers to publish for Dedicated after kernel update (do we update now or wait for full benchmarks?)
- Whether to pause public console rollout until logging bug fixed or ship with rollback note

Open questions for Marcus
- Is the KV cache miss root cause known? Any quick mitigation (config tweak) we can ship this week?
- How confident are you in the current canary infra to isolate latency regressions (metric fidelity, per-model tagging)?
- For Private: do we have a scoped list of customers who need the on-prem installer this quarter? Any that must be prioritized?

Draft talking bullets (short)
- "We saw P95 regressions in two customer cases tied to long-context sequences — can we prioritize a short-term config fallback?"
- "For batching + rate-limit change, propose 20% canary with dynamic rollback if P95 increases >10% or error-rate >0.2%"
- "For Dedicated SLAs, prefer to publish 'preliminary' numbers with a note about kernel change pending final benchmarks"

Action items / follow-ups (capture during meeting)
- Marcus to triage KV cache miss root cause and propose a config mitigation by 2026-02-16. (Owner: Marcus Li)
- Eng to provide safe canary size and runbook for hosted-api batching by EOD 2026-02-14. (Owner: Marcus / Dana)
- Marcus to share benchmark plan + ETA for Dedicated throughput with quantized models (target: 2026-02-20). (Owner: Marcus)
- I (Priya) to draft customer comms for Dedicated SLA update once benchmarks are available; hold PR draft. (Owner: Priya Shah)
- Dana to triage console rollout logging bug and estimate fix time (Owner: Dana Kim, due 2026-02-15).
- Add private-deploy priority list to next sync — I will pull from CSMs and send before Thursday. (Owner: Priya Shah, due 2026-02-14)

Notes-to-self (informal)
- If Marcus seems overloaded, consider pushing one non-critical console feature to next sprint (avoid risking rollout quality).
- Bring up possibility of temporarily turning off long-context heavy batching for specific customers to repro reliably.
- Remember to ask about infra monitoring gaps: are we missing per-model heatmaps in the new telemetry?

Past context links (for reference)
- RED-4123: customer A trace dump (linked)
- RED-4180: customer B latency thread
- Confluence: api-rollout-notes (high level plan)

End of prep. Keep it short in meeting, focus on unblock and clear owners.
